'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jonathan Murray LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''This deck is okay'''. Username '''Throdo'''. Neither LIGHT nor DARK box is checked; the list is Light and matches the hub cell. L8 sheet reads Wokling/Wohling (V) → Wokling (V). L11 one word read Aquens → Aquaris (uncertain). L17 Horox Ryyder. L20 written RON → Queen Amidala, Ruler Of Naboo. L25 written Menen → Liana Merian. L26 written Terdau Bundor → Tendau Bendon. L28 Qui-Gon with Saber → Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber. L30 Obi with Saber → Obi-Wan With Lightsaber. L33 margin star is not the start. L37 written R2D2 in Red 5 → Artoo-Detoo In Red 5. L50 written AWRI & DS → All Wings Report In & Darklighter Spin. L58 written Fallen Jedi (wiki title, not expanded). Shield 3 Simple Tricks And Nonsense box is empty.
